company_summary.one_line_business: Nebius, a global AI cloud platform, delivers a unified full-stack AI cloud that spans the complete AI journey – from compute capacity to software and services that enable fast and efficient training and inference at scale.

ai_exposure.summary: We believe that our core competitive advantages include: ●Our full-stack, AI-native cloud approach from silicon to software, with offerings spanning the entire AI cloud value chain - from data center compute, hardware to software solutions and production-scale token generation; ●Leading team of AI / ML and cloud engineers focused on developing our growing portfolio of tools and services to optimize and accelerate complex AI workloads at the AI cloud and AI Platform and Applications layers; ●Proven ability to engineer, develop, deploy and scale a wide variety of AI-native software and service technology businesses that customers demand; ●A comprehensive suite of AI services – from data preparation to app deployment and token generation– within a single environment, eliminating the need for multiple vendors and resulting in efficiencies, reduced operational complexity and improved ROI; ●Architecture optimized for large-scale AI deployments, enabling customers to scale their infrastructure quickly and easily up or down as needed, with auto-scaling capabilities that automatically adjusts infrastructure to match workload fluctuations, ensuring AI applications run at optimal efficiency; ●Strong track record of planning, building and operating energy- and resource efficient data centers with heavy power loads and high rack densities in a reliable, scalable manner, leading to high utilization rates; ●In-house hardware design, development and production with lower cost of ownership leading to faster time-to-market; ●Workload orchestration and optimization tools that allow customers to achieve scalable, efficient and sustainable outputs; ●Longstanding partnerships with critical AI hardware providers and leading server original equipment manufacturers (OEMs); ●Our Reference Platform NVIDIA Cloud Partner status, one of only a handful of AI cloud providers to meet these requirements globally, underscoring Nebius’s expertise in designing and deploying a full stack of hardware and software infrastructure that meets NVIDIA’s standards for AI and ML workloads; and ●Flexible access to affordable capital with a strong balance sheet.

translation_zh_tw.company_summary: Nebius 是一個全球性 AI 雲端平台，提供統一的全堆疊 AI 雲端服務，涵蓋完整的 AI 旅程——從計算能力到支援快速且高效率大規模訓練與推斷的軟體和服務。

ai_exposure.summary: 我們相信我們的核心競爭優勢包括：●採用從矽晶片到軟體的全堆疊 AI 原生雲端方案，涵蓋整個 AI 雲端價值鏈 — 從資料中心計算資源、硬體到軟體解決方案及生產規模的標記生成；●領先的 AI／機器學習及雲端工程團隊，專注於開發不斷成長的工具與服務組合，以優化並加速 AI 雲端及 AI 平台與應用層的複雜 AI 工作負載；●具備工程設計、開發、部署及擴展各類 AI 原生軟體與服務技術業務的驗證能力，以滿足客戶需求；●整合從資料準備到應用部署及標記生成的完整 AI 服務套件，集中於單一環境，無需多家供應商，提升效率、降低營運複雜度並改善投資報酬率；●優化架構適用於大規模 AI 部署，讓客戶依需求快速且輕鬆擴展或縮減基礎設施，配備自動擴展功能，自動調整資源以因應工作負載波動，確保 AI 應用達最佳效率；●在規劃、建造與營運高電力負載及高機櫃密度的能源與資源效率資料中心方面擁有良好紀錄，以可靠且可擴展的方式推動高使用率；●自行設計、開發及生產硬體，降低擁有成本並加快產品上市時程；●工作負載編排與優化工具，協助客戶達成可擴展、高效及永續的輸出效能；●長期與重要 AI 硬體供應商及領先伺服器原廠設備製造商 (OEM) 保持合作夥伴關係；●獲得 NVIDIA Cloud Partner 的參考平台認證，為全球少數符合此要求的 AI 雲端供應商之一，彰顯 Nebius 在設計與部署符合 NVIDIA AI 與機器學習工作負載標準的硬軟體基礎架構方面的專業；及●擁有靈活取得低成本資金的能力與穩健的財務狀況。

strategy_changes.change: 2025 年，我們推出 AI 發現獎，向從事癌症預測、蛋白質定位、轉錄組繪製及精準診斷等領域的初創公司提供 GPU 點數，旨在加速高影響力研究並促進初創與投資者間的合作。
